title: Police officer injured in accidental shooting in Rawalpindi
excerpt: A Dolphin Force officer on security duty for a tri-nation ODI cricket series in Rawalpindi was injured by an accidental gunshot.
body_html:
A member of the Dolphin Force sustained injuries due to an accidental gunshot while on security duty in Rawalpindi.

The officer had been deployed to ensure safety during the ongoing tri-nation ODI cricket series in the city. According to available reports, the injury resulted from his own weapon discharging accidentally.

Further details regarding the incident or the current condition of the injured officer were not immediately provided.
